name: Double Trouble's Blossom
source:
When you eventually return to Gardenville after moving 10 years ago, you are reunited with your childhood crush--I mean.. childhood friend.  Except, there's 2 of him??  Surprise, surprise, the boy you played with has a twin and unfortunately you're not quite sure which twin it is.  One twin is your childhood friend and the other is a very amused outsider in your story, will you find out which one is which?

[From [url=https://dhidhiand.itch.io/double-troubles-blossoming]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你十年前搬家后最终回到加登维尔时，你会与儿时的迷恋者重聚——我的意思是……儿时的朋友。除了，有两个他？惊喜，惊喜，和你一起玩的男孩有一个双胞胎，不幸的是你不太确定是哪一个。双胞胎中的一个是你儿时的朋友，另一个是你故事中非常有趣的局外人，你能找出哪个是哪个吗？

[来自[url=https://dhidhiand.itch.io/double-troubles-blossoming]itch.io[/url]]
